resources.string: A few settings so the alarm reaches you even when the screen is locked. You can catch up on anything missing later in Settings.
For the alarm and the running infusion.
So Android doesn\'t put the timer to sleep. On Samsung devices, also add UmamiT to “Never sleeping apps”.
Shows the infusion in the status bar and on the lock screen.
Shows the alarm over the lock screen.
Samsung sometimes restarts the phone at night. Afterwards a running timer only rings once you\'ve unlocked the phone. Under Battery and device care › Automatic optimization, turn off “Auto restart”.
Couldn\'t save. Tap again; is the storage full?
Make all teas from Tee-Kontor Kiel available offline, from green tea to chai. The first load takes about half an hour; you can use the app in the meantime.
The catalog keeps loading in the background, even with the phone locked. You can get started already.
Loading cancelled. You can load the catalog later under Collection › Catalog.
The catalog couldn\'t be loaded just now. You can try again later under Collection › Catalog.
Tap a tea under Recently brewed or start a New session. The timer guides you through every infusion, with a pre-alert and an alarm.
Two timers can run at once: two sessions, or a session and the quick timer. The row at the top switches to the other timer.
Load the Tee-Kontor Kiel catalog and add teas to My teas, or share a shop link with UmamiT. Recipes, stock and costs live on the tea.
Every session lands in the journal. Rate the tea and the brewing, note the taste of each infusion and keep good times in the recipe.
See what you drink: sessions, kinds, favourite teas, habits, use and cost per litre.
In Settings › Data & backup you save all your data to one file. Share a recipe from ⋮ in the recipe.
